subject.title: Skill Workshop apply approval is invisible to independent operator clients on 2026.7.1

question: Which operator audience should be authorized to observe and resolve a channel-originated Skill Workshop approval when no reviewer device is present in the agent context?
rationale: Broadening list visibility affects an approval and authorization boundary, while retaining requester-only visibility leaves legitimate channel-originated requests unreachable; repository intent is needed for the permanent audience rule.

options.title: Bind intended reviewer devices
options.body: Derive or inject the authorized owner/reviewer device set for channel-originated calls and keep unrelated operator clients unable to see the record.

options.title: Allow every approval operator
options.body: Make pending plugin approvals visible to every authenticated client with operator.approvals, simplifying recovery but broadening the approval audience.

options.title: Keep fail-closed behavior
options.body: Retain the current scoped visibility and document a separate CLI or Control UI lifecycle path for channel-originated requests.

recommendation.title: Bind intended reviewer devices
recommendation.body: Derive or inject the authorized owner/reviewer device set for channel-originated calls and keep unrelated operator clients unable to see the record.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent adjacent Skill Workshop lifecycle work makes steipete the strongest available owner for confirming the intended approval audience.
